name: Avoid Asgore as Dess [Deltarune]
desc:
THIS IS A REUPLOAD OF THE GAME!!! THE ORIGINAL GAME WAS LOST IN A SCAM!!! The other "Evade Asgore As Dess [Deltarune]" is being ran by scammers. If you would like proof please contact me via the community server. 

[Game is still in early access/beta, expect bugs and glitches]

A player is randomly chosen to be either a Driver or a Runner. The goal of the driver is to run over all other runners, while the goal of the runner is to survive for aslong as possible. Kromer that is earned during rounds can be spent on many new runners and drivers

Controls 

Pc : 
Shift to sprint
Q to use ability
E to use secondary ability

Mobile :
Onscreen buttons for everything

Game is heavily inspired by Undertale and Deltarune, most assets are from both of those.
